name: io.github.chrischall/aws-mcp
description: Apple Music playlists, iCloud Calendar/Contacts/Mail, Apple Maps and WeatherKit for Claude

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Needed for Apple Music (official API), Apple Maps and WeatherKit.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Key ID of a private key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys with Media Services (MusicKit), MapKit JS and/or WeatherKit enabled.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local installs only: a path to the .p8 file instead of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Music (pair with APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Music.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAPS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAPS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_SERVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx @chrischall/aws-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
environmentVariables.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SERVICES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the small on-disk caches (web-player token, iCloud discovery) under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.aws-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).
